poll.source_locator: Luria 46%, Kiggans 43%, Someone else 2%, Undecided 10%; 702 interviews of registered 2nd district voters who are likely general election voters, Oct 1-10, 2026; MoE +/-4.0%

pollster.weighting_quote: iterative weighting process on city/county, age, race, sex, and education to reflect as closely as possible the population of the second congressional district's November 3, 2026 electorate
pollster.mode: live telephone interviews (164 landline, 538 cell), Dynata interviewers
